sentences.text: Liam and Maya live in Oakhaven.
It is a small, quiet town.
The town has a big factory called BrightCorp.
Many people in Oakhaven work at the factory.
Liam’s father and Maya’s mother work there, too.
The factory is very important for the town.
Liam and Maya love to play near the river.
Yesterday, they went to their favorite spot.
But something was wrong.
The water was not clear.
It was a strange, dark color.
They also saw some sick fish near the rocks.
This was not normal.
They walked along the river.
Soon, Liam found a big pipe.
The pipe was coming from the direction of the BrightCorp factory.
A dark, oily liquid was running from the pipe into the river.
"Look!" Liam said.
Maya took a photo with her phone.
She looked very sad.
That night, they talked.
Liam was worried.
"Our parents work at BrightCorp," he said.
"If the factory has a problem, they can lose their jobs."
Maya was worried, too.
She looked at the photo on her phone.
The river looked very sick.
The problem was bigger than just their families.
"But the river is important for everyone," Maya said.
"The animals are sick.
We must do something.
We should tell someone."
Liam looked at his friend.
He knew she was right.
The next day, they went to the office of the local newspaper.
They were scared, but they were also brave.
They showed the photo to a journalist.
Her name was Ms. Evans.
She listened to their story carefully.
"You did the right thing," she said.
"I will help you."
Ms. Evans wrote an article in the newspaper.
At first, some people in the town were angry.
But then, they understood the problem.
Soon, BrightCorp promised to clean the river.
They said they will build a better, safer system.
Liam and Maya felt good.
They were happy because they helped their town.
